failure_findings.description: Phase 17 baseline backtests showed negative strategy performance, so the current signal logic is not acceptable for execution.
Parameter sweep and candidate review did not produce an execution-approved strategy candidate.
Historical expansion remains on hold, so current rework must treat available BTC/ETH datasets as limited research inputs only.
Paper shadow, micro-live, real live trading, and exchange order submission remain disabled.

source_failure_hypotheses.description: The strategy may be entering during poor market regimes without sufficient trend/range/volatility filtering.
Losses may not be controlled well enough by the existing exit logic, requiring stronger stop, trailing, time, and invalidation rules.
The gross signal edge may be too small after fees and slippage.
Parameter sweep results may be unstable or not robust enough across symbols.
BTC/ETH-only or limited timeframe coverage may be insufficient for reliable strategy approval.

hypothesis_plan.problem: Baseline strategy may enter during poor market regimes.
hypothesis_plan.planned_fix: Add trend/range/volatility regime classification before signal approval.
hypothesis_plan.test_method: Offline backtest only using existing BTC/ETH datasets.
success_criteria: Positive net return after fees and slippage

hypothesis_plan.problem: Signal direction may be too weak on a single timeframe.
hypothesis_plan.planned_fix: Require higher-timeframe alignment before approving entries.

hypothesis_plan.problem: Exit logic may not control losses well enough.
hypothesis_plan.planned_fix: Test ATR stop, trailing stop, time stop, and invalidation stop combinations.

hypothesis_plan.problem: Gross edge may disappear after fees and slippage.
hypothesis_plan.planned_fix: Reject signals unless expected edge exceeds fee and slippage buffer.
success_criteria: Net return remains positive after conservative slippage
Trade count remains sufficient for review

hypothesis_plan.problem: Parameter candidates may be unstable or overfit.
hypothesis_plan.planned_fix: Require candidate stability across symbols, parameter neighborhoods, and time windows.
success_criteria: Candidate does not depend on one narrow parameter set
Candidate survives BTC and ETH review
Candidate passes strict quality gate before any future execution review
